headlines.description: — Jalen Johnson had 29 points, 12 rebounds and 12 assists to lead the Atlanta Hawks to a 130-123 win over the Cleveland Cavaliers in an NBA Cup game on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Johnson's triple-double leads Hawks to 130-123 victory over Cavaliers in NBA Cup game

headlines.description: — Tyrese Maxey scored 22 points, Jared McCain had 20 off the bench and the Philadelphia 76ers beat the Brooklyn Nets 115-103 on Friday night in an NBA Cup game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tyrese Maxey scores 22 points, 76ers beat Nets 115-103

headlines.description: — Brandon Miller scored 27 points, Miles Bridges had 22 points, eight rebounds and seven assists and the Charlotte Hornets beat the Chicago Bulls 123-116 on Friday night to snap a seven-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Miller scores 27 points, Hornets beat Bulls 123-116 to end 7-game losing streak

headlines.description: — Desmond Bane scored 37 points and grabbed two crucial offensive rebounds as the Orlando Magic defeated the Detroit Pistons 112-109 on Friday night to win their NBA Cup group.
headlines.shortLinkText: Desmond Bane's 37 points and key rebounds help Magic beat Pistons 112-109 to win NBA Cup group

headlines.description: — Pascal Siakam had 24 points and 11 rebounds and the Indiana Pacers beat the Washington Wizards 119-86 on Friday night in an NBA Cup game between two of the league's worst teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pacers beat Wizards 119-86 in NBA Cup game between 2 of the league's worst teams

events.name: Milwaukee Bucks at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson scored 37 points and the New York Knicks advanced to the knockout round of the NBA Cup, beating the Milwaukee Bucks 118-109 on Friday night in Giannis Antetokounmpo's return from a groin injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Brunson scores 37 points as Knicks fend off Bucks 118-109 and advance in NBA Cup

events.name: Phoenix Suns at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had 37 points and eight assists and the Oklahoma City Thunder held on to beat the Phoenix Suns 123-119 on Friday night to reach the knockout round of the NBA Cup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thunder win 11th straight to improve to 19-1, beating Suns 123-119 to move on in NBA Cup

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Denver Nuggets

headlines.description: - Devin Vassell scored a season-high 35 points on the strength of 7-of-9 shooting from 3-point range and the San Antonio Spurs advanced to the NBA Cup quarterfinals with a 139-136 win over the Denver Nuggets on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vassell scores 35 points as Spurs beat Nuggets 139-136 to reach NBA Cup quarterfinals

headlines.description: — Keyonte George scored 31 points and Lauri Markkanen added 28 to help the Utah Jazz snap a four-game skid with a 128-119 victory over the Sacramento Kings on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: George and Markkanen help Jazz snap 4-game skid with 128-119 win over Kings

events.name: Dallas Mavericks at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — Austin Reaves scored 38 points, Luka Doncic added 35 points and 11 assists in his third meeting with his former team, and the Lakers spoiled Anthony Davis' return to Los Angeles with a 129-119 victory over the Dallas Mavericks on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reaves scores 38 points, Luka adds 35, Lakers hold off Mavs 129-119 in Anthony Davis' LA return

headlines.description: — Jaren Jackson Jr. scored 16 of his 24 points in the second half and the Memphis Grizzlies rallied for a 112-107 win over the Los Angeles Clippers in the last game of NBA Cup play for both teams on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grizzlies eliminated from NBA Cup despite riding strong second half to 112-107 win over Clippers
